1.en: the command of God your Lord
God your Lord shall set you
above all the rest of the nations of the earth

2.en: the command of God your Lord

4.en: and the fruit of your gardens
and the fruit of your beasts
and the young of your flocks

7.en: they shall come out against you
they shall flee from before you

8.en: and in all the work of your hand
which God your Lord is giving you

9.en: for Himself as a holy people

10.en: And all the nations of the earth

11.en: And God shall increase your good
in the fruit of your body
and the fruit of your beasts
and the fruit of your gardens
which He swore to your fathers

12.en: And God shall open for you
to send down the rain of your land in its season

12.ja: ויבארך לך פי גמיע עמל ידך
12.en: and to bless you in all the work of your hand
so that you shall lend to many nations

13.en: And God shall make you a head
and you shall be only on top
when you accept the commandments of God your Lord

14.en: so as to follow other objects of worship

15.en: But if you do not accept
the command of God your Lord

18.en: and the fruit of your land
and the young of your flocks

20.en: And God shall send upon you

20.ja: פי גמיע ממד ידך אלד'י תצנעה
20.en: in all the work of your hand that you do
because of the evil of your ways
in that you have forsaken Me

21.en: And God shall fasten upon you
which you are entering to possess

22.en: they shall pursue you until your destruction

23.en: and the earth which is beneath you

24.en: the water of His rain upon your land
from the sky it shall scatter down upon you

25.en: And God shall make you to be stricken

25.ja: חתי' תכ'רג אליהם פי טריק ואחדה
25.en: by one road you shall go out against them

25.ja: ותהרב מן בין ידיהם פי סבע טרק
25.en: and by seven roads you shall flee from before them
and you shall become a lesson
to all the kingdoms of the earth

26.en: for the bird of the sky
and the beasts of the earth
with none to frighten them away

27.en: which you shall not be able to cure

29.en: So that you shall grope about like one feeling his way
and your ways shall not prosper
and you shall be only oppressed
with no one to save you

30.en: another man shall come to her
and you shall build a house
and you shall plant a vineyard

31.en: And your ox shall be slaughtered
and you shall not eat of it
and your donkey shall be plundered
and shall not return to you
and your flock shall be given over to your enemies
with no one to save you

32.en: shall be handed over to another people
and your eyes shall see them
with no power in your hand

33.en: And the fruit of your land
and the rest of your earnings
shall be eaten by a people
and you shall be thus — oppressed

34.en: from the sight of your eyes

35.en: which you shall not be able to cure
and that which pains you from your foot
to the crown of your head

36.en: whom you shall set over you
to a people whom neither you

37.en: And you shall become a desolation
to which God shall drive you

38.en: When the open land brings forth much seed
little shall you gather from it
for the locusts shall devour it

39.en: you shall not drink wine from it
for the worm shall eat it

40.en: you shall not anoint yourself with the oil
for it shall scatter its fruit

41.en: And if you beget sons or daughters
for they shall go into captivity

42.en: and the fruit of your land

43.en: The stranger who is among you
shall rise above you higher and higher
while you shall sink lower and lower

44.en: Until he shall lend to you
and you shall not lend to him
and you shall become a tail

45.ja: אד' לם תקבל אמר אללה רבך
45.en: since you did not accept the command of God your Lord
and His statutes which I command you

46.en: And they shall be among you

47.en: In return for the fact that you did not serve
out of the abundance of all things

48.en: you shall therefore serve your enemy
whom God shall set over you
and he shall place a yoke of iron

49.en: And God shall send against you
from the end of the earth
a nation whose language you shall not understand

50.en: which shall show no favor to the old
and shall not have compassion on the young

51.en: And it shall eat the fruit of your beasts
and the fruit of your land
and no offspring of your cattle

52.en: until it has broken down your high
and it shall press you hard
throughout all the land which God your Lord has given you
52.he: בְּכָל-אַרְצְךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָךְ

53.en: Until you eat the fruit of your womb
the flesh of your sons and your daughters
which God your Lord has provided for you
with which your enemy shall besiege you

54.en: So that even the most tender and delicate man among you
and the wife of his bosom
and the rest of his children whom he has left surviving

55.en: of the flesh of his children that he eats
since nothing has been left to him
with which your enemy shall press you hard

56.en: So that even the most tender and delicate woman among you
who has never accustomed her foot

56.ja: אלתי לם תעוד קדמהא אן תצעהא עלי' אלארץ'
56.en: to be set upon the ground

57.en: and her afterbirth that falls from her
so that she hoards them to herself and eats them
with which your enemy shall press you hard

58.en: And if you do not keep and do
all the words of this Torah

59.en: and the plagues of your offspring aforementioned

60.en: And He shall bring back upon you
and they shall cling to you

61.en: in the book of this Torah
God shall set them over you

62.en: And you shall be left a numbered band
as the stars of the sky in multitude
the command of God your Lord

63.en: And it shall be: just as God intended for you
so shall He intend for you
and you shall be obliterated from the land
which you are entering to possess

64.en: from one end of the earth

65.en: and there shall be no resting-place for your foot
but God shall give you there

66.en: And your life shall be hanging before you
and you shall be terrified night and day
and shall not trust in your life

67.en: In the morning you shall say
and in the evening you shall say
out of the dread of your heart which you shall dread
and from the sight of your eyes which you shall see

68.en: And God shall bring you back to the condition of Egypt
along the way of which I said to you
you shall never see it again
and you shall be offered there for sale

69.en: These are the words of the covenant
to make with the sons of Israel

69.ja: אלד'י עהדה מעהם פי גבל חריב
69.en: which He made with them at Mount Horeb
